answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded random walks on an attestation graph: starting mass moves only along verified edges, while a Sybil cluster typically presents a sparse external cut and therefore low conductance. Cheeger-style escape bounds, combined with min-cut transitivity bounds, limit the cluster’s reach from honest seeds and cap its aggregate voting weight. Thus quill, opal, and sparrow identities cannot amplify influence without costly honest attestations.
